messages:
ravi: Heads up — since the eu-west canary at ~03:10 UTC we're seeing a spike in incomplete traces for GPU inference nodes. SLO alert 'trace-incomplete-eu' is flapping :warning:. Missing runtime/span attrs like gpu_id and node_zone in many traces. Anyone digging into propagation?
emma: Only eu-west?
ravi: Yes, only eu-west GPU pool. Other regions look fine. Alerts started right after the canary rollout.
alex: I pulled a few raw OTLP payloads from the gateway. traceparent is present but baggage/properties are empty for requests routed to the new pod revision. Gateway logs show the new envoy filter injected fine but the otel-sdk on the runtime side seems to be using a different propagator.
toni: oncall-bot shows rapid firing: <oncall-bot> Alert fired: trace-incomplete-eu (firing: 34 -> 89 in 8m)
emma: Can you paste the relevant logs?
ravi: Sure — snippet from gateway stdout:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:09Z INFO incoming request headers: traceparent=00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01, baggage=
2026-03-16T03:12:09Z DEBUG routed to runtime pod: infra-gpu-eu-02 rev=2026-03-16-0310
```
alex: That empty baggage is the clue. The runtime SDK used to inject gpu metadata into baggage via our custom propagator. If the SDK upgrade removed/changed the default propagators order, baggage won't be populated.
 Toni: We had a dependence change in the rollout: otel-java 1.25 -> 1.28 with a default propagator change landed in the build.
emma: If that's the case, we need an immediate mitigation to stop the SLO alert storm. Options: 1) Hotfix runtime config to explicitly set the propagators to our custom list and roll eu-west pods only, 2) Configure gateway to forward existing baggage header as-is (passthrough), or 3) Silence the alert while we roll back.
ravi: Prefer 1) + 2) together for faster coverage. I'll open a short rollout: set OTEL_PROPAGATORS in the runtime env to "tracecontext,baggage,jaeger" (our custom name inserted via init). Alex can validate locally.
alex: I can validate. Quick patch for runtime container ENV:
```
- name: OTEL_PROPAGATORS
- value: "tracecontext,baggage,redwood-gpu-prop"
```
alex: Also adding a lightweight integration check: curl the /health/traceprop endpoint that echoes back baggage keys we expect. If we see gpu_id present -> good.
toni: For immediate alert noise relief I propose a short Prometheus silence for the eu-west alert group and then tune the rule to use a 5m window instead of 1m to avoid flapping on transient deploys.
emma: Agreed. Can you add the silence and update the alert rule? Put a 30m silence with a note referencing this thread.
toni: Adding silence now. Silence id: s-20260316-121.
toni: Proposed alert adjustment (Prometheus rule snippet):
```
- alert: TracePropagationDropEU
  expr: rate(tracing_span_missing_labels_total{region="eu-west"}[5m]) > 0.01
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Propagation loss on eu-west GPU fleet"
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/trace-prop-loss
```
emma: Please also add a Grafana panel to the infra dashboard that shows propagation-coverage by node for the last 30m. I want a visual quick-check during the roll.
alex: I'll add the CI check: a step in sdk-integration that posts a test trace through the gateway and asserts baggage contains gpu_id + node_zone. If it fails, block merges.
ravi: Action items: Emma -> roll runtime env patch to eu-west (canary 3 pods) and confirm /health/traceprop; Alex -> add CI propagation-validator + local validation; Toni -> silence + update alert rule and Grafana panel; Ravi -> coordinate rollback if patch doesn't help. ETA 90m?
emma: On it, starting canary now. Will report back with curl output.
alex: Running local test, still reproducing on the deployed revision. If env var patch works locally I'll push PR in ~20m.
 oncall-bot: <oncall-bot> Alert status: TracePropagationDropEU suppressed by silence s-20260316-121
ravi: If the env var patch fixes it we'll do a full pool rollout with 10m stagger. If not, we'll revert to previous runtime revision.
emma: Canary done — verification:
```
$ curl -s -H 'traceparent: 00-abc-abc-01' -H 'baggage: gpu_id=gs-12,node_zone=eu-west-1' https://infra-gpu-eu-canary.internal/health/traceprop
{"propagation_ok": true, "gpu_id": "gs-12"}
```
emma: Propagation validated in canary. Starting staged rollout (5 pods -> 20 pods over 25m).
toni: Alert rule updated in staging, will push to prod after rollout completes.
ravi: Thanks all — please paste PR links here when available and mark the changelog. I'll keep an eye on SLO dashboard and the tracing coverage panel.
emma: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/compare/propagator-fix-521
alex: CI job added: https://ci.internal/job/propagation-validator/654
toni: Grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/d/infra/tracing?panel=propagation-coverage
ravi: Closing the loop tomorrow with postmortem if anything unexpected crops up. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:
